name: Raghuvir Synthetics Limited
about: Raghuvir Synthetics Limited engages in the manufacturing and processing of textiles in India. The company offers a range of bed linen/beddings, including bed spreads, flat and fitted sheets, comforters, bed skirts, and cover lets, as well as mattress, duvet, quilt, and pillow covers; curtains, such as decorative jacquards, tab curtains, textured, tie backs in various confections, valances, rod pocket, eyelet, folding and shower curtains, and other wind decorations; and towels comprising bath, hand, wash cloth, beach towels, and other products. It also provides kitchen products, including runners, place mats, tea cozy, aprons, kitchen bags, oven gloves, pot holders, and table covers with napkins; and upholstery products, such as cushion covers, chair pads, sofa sets, and iron board covers. In addition, the company exports its products. Raghuvir Synthetics Limited was founded in 1968 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
